summary: A 32-year-old Texas man stood on rocks above Judd Falls north of Gothic that gave way and tumbled ~300 ft down a steep, rocky slope into the river; swept down the rapids for several hundred feet before pulling himself onto shore with severe injuries. Eight CBSAR members set up a rope system, lowered a litter attendant ~300 ft down steep loose near-vertical rock, packaged the patient and raised him back up the slope, then carried him to a CBSAR vehicle for transport down a 4WD road to the CareFlight landing zone; ~3.5-hour operation.
responding_agency: Crested Butte Search and Rescue; Crested Butte Fire Protection District; Mt. Crested Butte Police Department; CareFlight
notes: Article published 2023-06-07 states he was flown to St. Mary's Hospital in Grand Junction and recovering. ~9:40 a.m. call. Distinct from the 2023-07-26 (id 1250) and 2015-07-08 (id 2521) Judd Falls falls.
